title: Cross-plugin whoami envelope (v1)
description: Authoritative JSON Schema for the coordinator-claude cross-plugin MCP whoami contract. All MCP-bearing plugins that implement a whoami introspection tool MUST produce responses conformant with this envelope. Owned by coordinator-claude; implemented independently in each plugin's own repo. See docs/wiki/cross-plugin-whoami-contract.md for the normative spec.

contract_version.description: Version of the cross-plugin whoami contract. Starts at 1. This is orthogonal to each plugin's own internal envelope version (which surfaces inside extras[<plugin>] if at all) and orthogonal to addon-protocol hookspec versioning (ADDON_PROTOCOL_VERSION). Do not collapse these three counters.

plugin_name.description: Canonical plugin identifier. Used as the key under which plugin-specific extras are nested (e.g. extras['project_rag']). Examples: 'project-rag', 'holodeck-control'.

plugin_version.description: Plugin's own version string (semver or similar). Null is permitted for plugins without semver discipline yet.

binding.description: Binding state — whether this plugin is bound to a concrete project or runtime target.

kind.description: Binding disposition. 'bound' = plugin is bound to a specific target and operating normally. 'unbound' = plugin is running but has no target (null target is unbound, not a mismatch — inherits the null-source semantic from plugin-identity-and-health-sentinels.md). 'degraded' = plugin has a target but cannot fully serve it (partial availability).

target.description: Plugin-specific identifier for what this plugin is bound to. For project-rag: the project root path. For holodeck-control: the .uproject file path. Null when kind is 'unbound'.

status.description: Operational health of the plugin at the time of the whoami call. This reflects live state, not a cached receipt — the live-not-receipt invariant applies (see plugin-identity-and-health-sentinels.md).

state.description: Health state. 'healthy' = plugin is fully operational. 'degraded' = plugin is partially operational (some capabilities unavailable). 'error' = plugin cannot serve its primary function.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the plugin entered the current state, if known. Null is permitted when the plugin does not track state-change timestamps.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the current state. Required on 'degraded' and 'error' states; null is acceptable on 'healthy'.

extras.description: Per-plugin extension slot. Each plugin identifies itself by a canonical snake_case key (e.g. 'project_rag', 'holodeck_control') and places its plugin-specific fields under that key. Coordinator validates: (a) extras is a dict, (b) all keys match the snake_case pattern below. Coordinator does NOT validate extras contents — those are per-plugin concerns validated by each plugin against its own schema.

additionalProperties.description: Plugin-specific extension data. Must be a dict (not a list or scalar). Contents are owned and validated by the plugin that writes this slot.

examples._comment: ANNOTATION-ONLY — project-rag conformant response. Demonstrates: binding to a project root, healthy state, project_rag extras slot carrying per-plugin fields including the plugin's own internal envelope_version counter (orthogonal to contract_version).

ANNOTATION-ONLY — holodeck-control conformant response. Demonstrates: binding to a .uproject file, healthy state, holodeck_control extras slot carrying UE-specific fields. Extras key uses plugin canonical id with underscores (holodeck_control, not holodeck-control — hyphens are not valid in extras keys per the ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$ pattern).
